Proposition
[fundamental equations on Jacobi fields]

Source: petersen:page-0117 ↗ def:pet-ch3-jacobi-field ↗ prop:pet-ch3-distance-function-curvature-equations

For Jacobi fields $J_1,J_2$, equations (1) and (3) of subsection 2.3 become \[ \partial _rg(J_1,J_2)=2\operatorname {Hess}r(J_1,J_2),\qquad \partial _r\big(\operatorname {Hess}r(J_1,J_2)\big)-\operatorname {Hess}^2r(J_1,J_2)=-R(J_1,\partial _r,\partial _r,J_2). \]
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch3-jacobi-field-curvature-equations

\sketch Evaluate the Lie-derivative equations for $g$ and $\operatorname {Hess}r$ on $J_1,J_2$. The terms differentiating the fields vanish because $\mathcal L_{\partial _r}J_i=0$, leaving the two ordinary $\partial _r$-derivatives in the statement.

□
